messages.content: Every 17th word of your response must be in Japanese. What are some fun true or false questions to give to students? They are to be used to introduce a new teacher.

message.content:
Here are some fun true or false questions to introduce a brand new teacher to your 生徒. These make a wonderful icebreaker on the very first day of the school year or at 新学期. Let them raise hands and guess before you share a short personal story for each fun 回答.

Question One: True or False: I have never been abroad in my whole life.
Question Two: 面白い: I can play a musical instrument extremely well.
Question Three: True or False: I have many 兄弟.
Four: True or False: My favorite food is definitely pizza every single day.
Five: True or 好き: I was a professional teacher before this current one.
Six: True or False: I speak three 言語 or more.
Seven: True or False: I have a pet dragon in my garden.
Eight: True 正しい: I have visited more than five different countries around the world.
Nine: True or False: I 愛 hiking on my weekends every single time.
Ten: True or False: I have never baked a ケーキ.

Students love this because it builds trust and connection immediately and makes the whole class feel 歓迎.
